about:
Taylor Packaging Corporation has operated from Imperial, Missouri since 1980. The company was founded as a family-owned business and continues as a female-owned and operated enterprise. Its Midwest location is intended to reduce shipping lead times and costs for customers across the region.

The company manufactures custom thermoformed plastic packaging, offering a full range of services from design and prototyping through tooling, production, assembly, and fulfillment. It runs a stock tooling program that includes more than 300 standard cavities and blisters and over 100 clamshell sizes, which can eliminate or reduce tooling expenses and accelerate time to market. Materials processed include clear, recycled, virgin, and color-matched plastics.

Taylor Packaging serves retail and shipping sectors, along with various other industries that require custom plastic packaging for product visibility and protection. Its VersaCLAM™ line provides ready-to-use clamshell and blister solutions, while custom development supports unique product presentations.

The company emphasizes sustainable practices, reporting a 95% recycling rate for production scrap and powering its facility with LED lighting and solar panels. Its female leadership has been recognized by the St. Louis Business Journal as a Top Women Business Owner for multiple years, and the operation was featured on the ION Television Network’s “World’s Greatest” series.
